title: Mirror member is in a degraded state

definition.name: [InterSystems IRIS] Mirror member is in a degraded state on {{host.name}}

description: Alerts when a mirror member leaves the primary (2), backup (3), or connected (4) state, reducing or removing failover protection. Covers not-initialized (1) and states 5-9 (transition through crashed). Instances that are not mirror members do not report this metric, so it stays silent on them.
